data.motto: a discovered problem is not a completed deliverable

items.description: Historical V6 original FAIL needs a validity adjudication that does not rewrite the record
items.rootCause: V6 semantic input defect
items.implementedFix: superseding adjudication beside the preserved FAIL; attempt registry layered; Candidate 2 effective status FORMAL_VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE
items.verification: 13 original artifacts bound by sha256; adjudication gates all pass

items.description: hard-coded calibration store imports in the runner profile map
items.rootCause: buildRunnerProfileMap hard-coded v3+v4 imports
items.implementedFix: versioned store registry; profileMap loads through it and no longer knows store names
items.verification: registry audit: 5 stores, 560 profiles, order-independent, 0 unregistered

items.description: v5/v6 stores omitted from the runner map — every V6 player fell back
items.rootCause: v5/v6 stores missing from the map
items.implementedFix: all four base stores plus enrichment registered
items.verification: 80/80 V6 players resolve FULL_RECORD; resolution audit pass

items.description: manifest fallback used instead of full records when full records exist
items.rootCause: runner substituted 13-field manifest rows
items.implementedFix: validateCalibrationRecord refuses incomplete records; manifest-row negative path refused in dry run
items.verification: manifestRowRefused negative path INCOMPLETE_RECORD

items.description: profile adapter contract undefined; 12 of 18 inputs silently absent
items.rootCause: no adapter contract existed
items.implementedFix: 18-field typed contract with prohibitions, enforced pre-adapter
items.verification: contract holds on all 560 records

items.description: NaN decade values on every V6 subject side
items.rootCause: NaN seasonStartYear on manifest rows -> NaN decade
items.implementedFix: NaN season refused at validation; output validator refuses NaN decade
items.verification: 0 NaN decades across 560 built profiles

items.description: uniform hidden spacingGravity fallback (4.30) across all sixteen sides
items.rootCause: absent shootingProfile object -> silent uniform spacing fallback
items.implementedFix: absent shootingProfile OBJECT refused; explicit null fields allowed with recorded fallback
items.verification: missingShootingProfileObjectRefused negative path; fallback audit has 0 hidden averages

items.description: subject/reference profile-path asymmetry
items.rootCause: subjects resolved via manifest rows, references via full store records
items.implementedFix: one registry, one resolver, one contract for both
items.verification: parity artifact: 0 unexplained asymmetry, full resolution both sides

items.description: offensiveRoles empty across all 560 active calibration records
items.rootCause: offensiveRoles never populated by any store builder
items.implementedFix: enrichment backfill: 377 role sets with provenance, 183 explicit INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
items.verification: role coverage artifact; 0 silent empty roles

items.description: defensive evidence missing on most post-1974 records (e.g. a DPOY season rating near average)
items.rootCause: post-1974 records carried no documented defensive evidence
items.implementedFix: person-prior bands from public-card award counts, decade-matched
items.verification: 37 bands added; DPOY-season Garnett floors at 8.5 interior

items.description: runner preflight unable to detect an incomplete profile map before access
items.rootCause: no preflight could detect an incomplete profile map
items.implementedFix: 19-check preflight module + mock dry run with negative paths
items.verification: all negative paths refuse; access deltas 0

items.description: diagnostic cluster recorder read observed/reference — fields absent from the trait schema
items.rootCause: cluster recorder read fields absent from the trait schema
items.implementedFix: readTraitField throws on unknown fields; validateHardFailCluster refuses null means
items.verification: unit-verified at module creation; regression tests added this phase

items.description: movement under-expression (persistent V6 diagnostic)
items.rootCause: coach movement intent annihilated by roster reach() gate (engine) — residual on SA is reference personnel geometry
items.implementedFix: INTENT_CARRY (Candidate 3) + prospective claim-support checker for reference-geometry cases
items.verification: mirror controls: low-roster lever -0.0006 -> +0.024; SA counterfactual lever +0.047 > 0.030 margin

items.description: assisted-offense under-expression (persistent V6 diagnostic)
items.rootCause: postThreat proxy distorted mixes; Boston residual was coach-phase data granularity
items.implementedFix: postThreat derivation repair (Candidate 3); assistedRate claim-support rule (coach ballMovement >= 6)
items.verification: Boston assistedRate clears its margin in the Candidate 3 corrected diagnostic

items.description: defensive suppression under-expression (persistent V6 diagnostic)
items.rootCause: missing defensive evidence on post-1974 records + stale baselines
items.verification: Boston refPppVsTeam cluster clears in the Candidate 3 corrected diagnostic

items.description: post-up identity residual (Houston 2007-08 persistent diagnostic)
items.rootCause: rebound-dominated postThreat set post-up baselines by non-scorers
items.verification: Houston postUpShare clears; corpus has zero sub-10-ppg players at postThreat 7+

items.description: rebounding identity residual (Portland 1974-75 persistent diagnostic)
items.rootCause: same postThreat defect through the reference mix
items.verification: Portland orebRate clears in the Candidate 3 corrected diagnostic

items.description: pace residual (Houston 2007-08 persistent diagnostic)
items.rootCause: coach-phase numeric granularity: Adelman's single record carries career-blend tempo 7; the 2007-08 slow phase is not representable without owner-curated per-phase coach data
items.implementedFix: claim-support rule: pace claims require |coachTempo - 5| >= 1 in the claimed direction at selection time, so an unsupported claim is never scored
items.verification: pace machinery verified exact (expected 92.35 vs observed 92.08); fallback rule encoded in claimSupport.mjs
items.externalDependency: owner-curated, source-backed per-phase coach system data

items.description: prior-phase artifacts that can overwrite themselves (frozen producers)
items.rootCause: artifact producers defaulted to their original output paths
items.implementedFix: --out/--dir flags defaulting to original paths; frozen producers already carry --refreeze guards
items.verification: candidate3 measurement writes to 6c4d0 without touching measurement-candidate2.json

items.description: non-accessing commands that write output
items.rootCause: asserted risk from an earlier phase
items.verification: the 6C4C3 preflight measured all eight non-accessing command modes: zero seals opened, zero formal outputs written, access counts 0->0 across every invocation (phase6c4c3-preflight.json commandSurfaces)

items.description: stale tests that pin historical access counts at literal values
items.resolutionEvidence: stale literal pins converted to live lineage assertions (generation-3 succession, registry-read versions); vitest 1963/1963; tests/v6c4d0-preview-candidate.test.js adds 17 pinned assertions

items.description: preview candidate/result identity requirements
items.resolutionEvidence: every preview result embeds the LOCKED Candidate 3 identity (candidate block + possession fingerprint pc1.3.0/al2.1.0); replay-stable over 40 soak probes; previewCandidateIdentity() reported in /api/health

items.description: preview cache/persistence isolation
items.resolutionEvidence: six preview-* namespaces (result/probability/narrative/competition/daily/challenge); pv_ result-id prefix end-to-end; preview records persist only under preview-result:*; preview:security 9/9

items.description: production fallback requirements (engine 3.2.0 must remain the fallback)
items.resolutionEvidence: PREVIEW_SIM_ENGINE_ENABLED defaults false (emergency-off returns every new request to production); guard + try/catch route any preview failure to computeResultV3 (engine 3.2.0) per request with fallback_invoked telemetry; playwright 19/19 with flag off
